notes.title: First Update - Big Changes to Controls
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44829665/1888dea9c4dfd648d1fe5a2c9a86bd76a2e943d2.png[/img]

[h3]We apologize for underestimating the impact of the lack of mouse control. We’ve made significant improvements:[/h3]


[h3]Controls: [/h3]
You can now use the mouse to rotate the camera around Kaya. Forward movement is now always oriented based on the camera’s direction.

[h3]Cursor Visibility:[/h3]
Fixed the issue where the cursor would disappear when entering the menu a second time.

[h3]Music Transition:[/h3]
Addressed the issue where background music from one area would continue playing while another area’s music was also active, leading to overlapping tracks.


Thank you for your understanding and continued support as we enhance the game!
